item.title: Show HN: A Rosetta Stone for UI component libraries
item.summary: A tool that maps UI components across MUI, Chakra, Ant Design, Mantine, EUI, Bootstrap, Quasar, Angular Material, and more. Every mapping is hand-verified — no AI guessing.
